page_title: LIV 4-1 LUT | Liverpool v Luton 21/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Andros Townsend (Luton) whips in a cross from the corner, but Caoimhin Kelleher is well positioned and punches the ball away.
90+6' A cross into the box from Jordan Clark (Luton) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Luton will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+6' Teden Mengi (Luton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+3' Jayden Danns (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' 4 - 1 Goal! Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top left corner. 4:1.
89' Issa Kabore (Luton) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Andy Madley didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
89' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with James McConnell (Liverpool) replacing Alexis Mac Allister.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jayden Danns (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch so that Luis Diaz can be given a rest.

88' Ross Barkley (Luton) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
87' The free kick is taken by Andros Townsend (Luton), but ball is cleared.
87' Andy Madley couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) and blew his whistle. That's a free kick to Luton.
84' Ross Barkley (Luton) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
84' Luton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' Luton couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Caoimhin Kelleher (Liverpool) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
82' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Andy Madley ignores the protests.

81' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
78' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with the free kick into the box, but the keeper reacts superbly and denies the effort.
78' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ryan Gravenberch will be replaced by Bobby Clark (Liverpool).
77' Ross Barkley (Luton) sees a yellow card from Andy Madley after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

77' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
76' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends it out of play.

76' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.

75' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Luis Diaz (Liverpool) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Thomas Kaminski pulls off a brilliant save.
74' Issa Kabore (Luton) comes onto the pitch after Alfie Doughty signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
73' The game is interrupted now, Alfie Doughty (Luton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
72' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
71' 3 - 1 Luis Diaz (Liverpool) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the left post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Luton.
68' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Luton have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Today's match ends for Conor Bradley who will be replaced by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool).
66' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
66' Alfie Doughty (Luton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Luton are awarded a corner kick.
65' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

65' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
65' Teden Mengi (Luton) commits a rough foul. Andy Madley stops the game and makes a call. Liverpool are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
63' It is time for a substitution. Jordan Clark (Luton) is on for Tahith Chong.
61' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
60' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) will take the corner.

60' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski pulls off a brilliant save. Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
58' 2 - 1 Goal! Alexis Mac Allister swings the ball deep into the box and finds Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the roof of the net. 2:1.
58' That's the end of the game for Cauley Woodrow, who is replaced by Andros Townsend (Luton).

56' 1 - 1 Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the left side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
56' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) will take a corner kick.

56' Thomas Kaminski pulls off a great save to deny Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
55' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
54' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

54' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
53' The linesman raises his flag. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.
52' Liverpool failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
52' Surely that's handball by one of the Luton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
51' Wow, what an escape. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
50' A shot from the edge of the box by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
48' The game is interrupted. Teden Mengi (Luton) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Rob Edwards probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton). He is replaced by Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+2' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
44' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher comes off his line to gather the ball.
43' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) tries to find Luis Diaz, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
42' Today's referee Andy Madley rightly decides to book Cauley Woodrow (Luton) for his harsh tackle.

41' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
40' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
40' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andy Madley blows for a foul.

35' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
34' Ross Barkley (Luton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Caoimhin Kelleher, who smothers the ball.
33' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
32' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.

30' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Thomas Kaminski thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

28' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
25' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
22' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
22' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
21' Andy Madley blows his whistle. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) commits a foul after dangerous play.
18' A yellow card for a tackle by Alfie Doughty (Luton). Andy Madley doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
18' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
17' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
15' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

13' Tahith Chong (Luton) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Caoimhin Kelleher, who tips the ball around the post.
12' 0 - 1 Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 0:1.
11' Alfie Doughty (Luton) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
10' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski was alert and made an amazing save!
10' Liverpool quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
10' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
9' The resulting corner from Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
9' Teden Mengi (Luton) commits a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for an infringement.
7' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

5' A short pass finds Luis Diaz (Liverpool) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
3' Amari'i Bell (Luton) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Andy Madley blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
2' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
2' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) works the corner short.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Luton will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Andy Madley.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
